comparison.objective: Drive a piston through a ring compressor into a bore while holding the compressor against the engine deck.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual fixture stabilization, coaxial piston alignment, and sustained insertion force; no impact-fracture or fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Piston passes through the held compressor into the bore. The record supplies no numeric seating, damage, or retention rubric.
comparison.reason: Both require coaxial tool-part alignment and bimanual stabilization, but the tested outcomes differ materially: constrained piston insertion versus contact-driven notch fracture followed by recovery of four free tangs without coil or shell damage.
